description:
Numbers the trunk's carrier will sell, with the carrier's own monthly_cost and upfront_cost in its currency. Free, and changes nothing. Only on a trunk with can_buy_numbers (Twilio, Telnyx, Plivo, Vobiz, Vonage, Exotel). Buy one with purchase_phone_number.

Requires scope `phone_numbers:read`.

area_code.description: Digits the national number should start with, where the carrier supports it.

name: search_available_numbers
title: Search for numbers to buy
